description:
Do-eun, a freshly discharged college student, goes out with In-hyuk, whom she likes, but, in fact, she is asexual. At the moment of understanding the difference between asexual and asexual people and confirming their feelings, the moment they are about to have a happy relationship, Do-eun's older brother Do-won and her blind date Yuri, who interfere with the two, appear... The 1st Lezhin Comics BL Contest Grand Prize Winner!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/romanticaplus), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/romanticap/), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000055529), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9347450)
